Posted March 19, 2003
Analysis by Richard Cowan

Whatever one may think of the Iraqi war, it should be axiomatic that our troops deserve the best support that we can give them, especially medical care and protection from the weapons of mass destruction, which are the putative cause of the war.

It is therefore morally outrageous, or, to use the President's own word, Evil, that we are depriving them of substances of proven medical value, whole cannabis and cannabis preparations.
See
They've Lied to Us About Marijuana, So How Do We Know That They Aren't Lying About Iraq? Credibility in Time of War.

First, we must deal with the problem of the giggle factor, the pervasive attitude that nothing about cannabis can be seriously discussed. Like, yeah, man we want our soldiers stoned? Giggle, giggle. This is deadly serious. It is not about recreational use, even though that might be helpful to deal with battle stress or fatigue.

That is another subject, but it should be noted that American pilots are often given amphetamines for use on long flights, and Xanax to come down on. The America pilots involved in the friendly fire deaths of four Canadian soldiers in Afghanistan were allegedly using them. Somehow no one giggles at the thought of pilots on speed.

The subject here is medical use in the most basic sense.

First, cannabis has been proven to protect the brain from both violent injury and poisoning by nerve gas, according to the US Army!

In 1998 U.S. Army tests, rats injected with Dexanabinol, Pharmos synthetic version of cannabidiol, (CBD) one of the constituents in whole cannabis, were more than 70 percent less likely to suffer epileptic seizures or brain damage after exposure to sarin and other nerve gases.
See
Could Medical Marijuana Have Prevented Gulf War Syndrome?
Derivative Combats Nerve Gas, Say Israeli Reports
and
 Marijuana Derivative Blocks Irreversible Brain Damage After Accidents;
Another Way Marijuana Prohibition Kills
and
 Cannabis May Prevent Brain Damage From Strokes; Slow Progress of Alzheimers and Parkinsonism
DEAland National Institute of Mental Health Study, But Reported In British Media
Also Pharmos website provides a description of how cannabidiol protects the brain after a head injury.
See
http://www.pharmoscorp.com/development/dexanabinol.html

Is there any doubt that, if cannabidiol were a derivative of any other plant, it would have been approved for use long ago? The need is urgent, and the risk is negligible. (Currently, to treat possible nerve gas exposure the troops are given atropine, which is highly toxic and can cause hallucinations!)

However, it is not always possible to provide injections of synthetics in battlefield conditions, but the resin of special strains of whole cannabis could be provided for both first aid and a prophylactic when the troops may be exposed to nerve gases, etc.

Second, cannabis has been proven to alleviate neuropathic (resulting from nerve damage or disease) pain of the sort associated with severe injury to the spine or a limb, or severe burns, which would be an excellent use for a topical preparation.

Whole-cannabis-based creams, such as that developed by Steve Tuck, could be well suited for first aid, especially for unconscious soldiers, and also as a prophylactic in cases of possible nerve poison exposure.

Third, cannabis is also proven to reduce the amount of opiates needed to treat pain. Supplementing opiates with cannabis could allow the injured soldier to function better under battlefield conditions by being less sedated.
See
 Live Free or Die In Pain. The Ignorance and Arrogance of the Quacks Who Deny Pain Relief to the Sick and Dying.
and
" Cannabis could form the basis for an entirely new approach to pain. "
" Why marijuana is emerging as such a panacea. "

If these substances work so well, why would even cannabis-based synthetics be resisted?

We may find the answer by taking a look at the single exception, because there is one cannabis-based drug, Marinol, which is sometimes promoted as making medical whole cannabis unnecessary.
See
 Marinol Was The First Schedule 2 Drug To Be " Down-Scheduled, "
Boasts Roxanne On Its New Marinol.com Web Site.
Doesn't That Mean That It Should Never Have Been Schedule 2 Anyway?

However, it was not until after the victory of the 1998 medical cannabis initiatives, that they really started touting it.
See
Two Days After The Medical Marijuana Initiatives
The DEA Proposes Making Marinol A Schedule III Drug!! " Like Codeine With Tylenol. "
More Like Cynicism With Desperation

Marinol is synthetic THC, an analog of the principle psychoactive ingredient, but the problem with Dexanabinol is that it proves that Marinol is not the same as whole cannabis. (The same applies to GW Pharmaceuticals solutions of whole cannabis.)
See
The British Medical Journal Continues Its Mediocre Coverage of the Cannabis Issues and The Media Continue Their Wretched Journalism. Missing Essential Point That A Cannabinoid Is Not Whole Cannabis

The refusal to allow cannabis to be used medically, even in wartime by our troops in the field, demonstrates that everything has been subordinated to the war on cannabis. Even the war on terror is less important than the suppression of medical cannabis.
See
The Endless Cynicism of the Drug Warriors. The Drug War and Terrorism. MarijuanaNews Analysis by Richard Cowan
and
Ashcroft Calls Press Conference to Announce War On Bongs. 55 Indicted. Priorities in the Age of Terror. Full Text of DOJ Press Release.

During World War II, the allies made common cause with Stalin, the mafia in Sicily, and the Vichy French in liberated North Africa. Victory over fascism was paramount.

Today, as we are going to war against an enemy said to have the most terrible weapons imaginable, we are depriving our troops of protection against these weapons.

With the nation on the second highest level of terror alert, we are still arresting peaceful cannabis users, even near Ground Zero in New York City.
See
Dude, You're Getting A Journalism Lesson. The Media Won't Report How Many Cannabis Arrests There Are In DEAland, or New York City, But This Celebrity Arrest Is Even Reported In The Washington Post.

If the exigencies of our time require that we go halfway around the world to fight a war, then they demand that our government get its priorities straight. Anything less is treason. Yes, treason.
See
 Is the War On Drugs A Just War. "? Should It Be Easier To Justify Violence Against A Foreign Dictatorship Than Against Peaceful Citizens Of One's Own Country?
